main.description: The access level a role holds in one room — one record per (role, room) pair, written to the space's repo. Clearing the level deletes it.

role.description: The role: the record key of a `space.roomy.space.role` record. The record key is `<role>~<room>`.

room.description: The room: the record key of a `space.roomy.space.room` record.
